All EPF exempted establishments

Subject: - Pattern of Investment for EPF Exempted Establishments.
Sir,

Reference has been received as to how the investment made by the Exempt Provident
Fund Trusts under the Pattern of Investment notified in 2003 is to be treated under the new

pattern of investment, particularly, if the asset has not been approved under the new pattern or
if the asset has been approved it carries certain restrictions relating to limit of it’s investments.

The matter has been examined by EPFO and it is clarified that the new Pattern of
Investment will be applicable from the date mentioned in the notification and not
retrospectively. Accordingly, the past investments as on the date of effect of new Pattern will be
regulated by the past pattern (issued in 2003) only.

Further, in case any establishment is desirous of aligning the existing investments to the
new Pattern of Investment, it can exercise the option as mentioned in Paras 4 & 5 of the new
Pattern of Investment—/).0 |5
